title: Embedding of witness coordinates
statement: Let $r$ be a natural number and let $J$ be a set of coordinates in $0,\\ldots,r-1$. Enumerating the elements of $J$ gives an embedding of the set of indices from zero to $|J|-1$ into the coordinates from zero to $r-1$, with image exactly $J$.
